name: clear-skies-portal
description: Finds the most recent satellite imagery for any location on Earth, plus lidar terrain. All sources free, no API key.
author: RileyG44

scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check wadnr.js && node --check wadnr-ingest-worker.js && node --check dnr-raster-source.mjs && node --check public-terrain.js && node --check public-terrain-worker.js && node --check terrain-pool.js && node --check terrain-worker.js && node --check terrain-core.js && node --check terrain-raster.js && node --check terrain-drape-core.js && node --check terrain-drape-pool.js && node --check terrain-drape-worker.js && node --check elevation-tile-core.js && node --check wa-archaeology.js && node --check glacial-research-core.js && node --check research-analysis.js && node --check research-worker.js && node --check point-cloud-core.js && node --check point-cloud-viewer.js && node --check cog.js && node --check png-stream.js && node --check markup.js && node --check usgs.js && node --check electron/main.js && node scripts/check-static.js
scripts.test: node test-coordinate-search.js && node test-png-stream.js && node test-markup-server.js && node test-markup-render.js && node test-map-readout.js && node test-glass-motion.js && node test-tile-pipeline.js && node test-public-terrain.js && node test-elevation-loading.js && node test-mesh-refine.js && node test-mesh-borders.js && node test-layer-transitions.js && node test-point-cloud.js && node test-maxar-catalog.js && node test-terrain-core.js && node test-terrain-raster.js && node test-wa-archaeology.js && node test-usgs-render.js && node test-mosaic.js && node test-elevation-bands.js && node test-elevation-tile-core.js && node test-glacial-research-core.js && node test-nadi1.js && node test-research-analysis.js && node test-cog.js && node test-terrain-pool.js && node test-wadnr.js && node test-server.js && node test-terrain-drape.js
scripts.verify: npm run vendor && npm run check && npm test && npm audit --omit=optional
scripts.icon: node build/make-icon.js && rm -rf build/icon.iconset && mkdir -p build/icon.iconset && for s in 16 32 128 256 512; do sips -z $s $s build/icon-1024.png --out build/icon.iconset/icon_${s}x${s}.png >/dev/null; sips -z $((s*2)) $((s*2)) build/icon-1024.png --out build/icon.iconset/icon_${s}x${s}@2x.png >/dev/null; done && iconutil -c icns build/icon.iconset -o build/icon.icns && rm -rf build/icon.iconset

extendInfo.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Clear Skies Portal uses your location only to centre the map on where you are.
extendInfo.NSHumanReadableCopyright: MIT licensed. Imagery from Copernicus, NASA, USGS and WA DNR.
